_schema: Bag rules the tuner sweeps (HANDOFF R1, R2, R17, R18). mercy: whether the hidden redraw is on. mercyScope: "solvable" (R18, launch: redraw unless the three shapes can all be placed in some order, counting clears), "draw" (R1: redraw only when none of the three fits anywhere), or "hand" (R17: reserved, not implemented). mercyAttempts: redraws tried before dealing the original anyway. killThreshold: placement count after which the mercy chance starts falling. killHalfLife: placements over which the mercy chance halves after the threshold; chance = 0.5 ^ ((placements - killThreshold) / killHalfLife), clamped to 1 before the threshold. weights: optional per-shape-id overrides of data/shapes.json weights, so the tuner can sweep without editing the shape file. killThreshold 80 / killHalfLife 50 were chosen from the bot sweep on 2026-09-25 (R5 in band; kill rule engages on ~24% of greedy runs); UNVERIFIED until live data.
